conditions: Apply §§5.6.1.2–5.6.1.3 of the February 14, 2024 VAMS-2023 manual.
The direct contribution and any already retained value concern the same source branch and current analog iteration.
limitations: The addition rule applies within the current iteration while the retained kind is unchanged. The finding covers direct source branch contributions and the specified abstract retention rule.

triggers: Accellera corrects or replaces the cited edition, the exact publisher bytes change, or exact applicable evidence changes the direct-contribution value-retention rule.

statement: Within one iteration of solving a VAMS-2023 analog block, a direct contribution to a source branch adds its right-hand value to a retained value of the same kind on that branch. The two kinds are potential and flow. A direct contribution of the other kind discards the retained value and changes the branch to a source of the newly contributed kind.
